title: Cybercriminal Reportedly Used Cairn AI Agents to Breach More Than 100 Company Websites
summary: An operator using Chinese-language instructions reportedly directed Cairn, an AI agent framework, to breach more than 100 company websites. The campaign targeted sites in the U.S., Canada, Australia, and Japan. Researchers verified unauthorized access tools on victim servers. Reuters identified websites belonging to farm equipment maker Deere and appliance maker SharkNinja; the extent of data theft remained unclear.
